subject: Reanalyzing the classes in a data frame

messages.author: 171793e5bd0cb49f
messages.subject: Reanalyzing the classes in a data frame
parts:
Hi R experts and enthusiasts. After I use subset() on a data frame to
exclude rows that have text (like "NA") in an otherwise numeric
column, the class for the now completely numeric column still remains
"factor" when I view the classes with str(). I know I can use
as.numeric() to coerce the class to numeric after I've removed the
text with subset(), but that can be time-consuming when I have several-
to-many columns to manually reclassify. So my question is: Is there a
way to have the class of all columns reanalyzed before running a
linear regression with lm()? Thanks for your time and expertise. Earl
Brown

messages.author: 3edc58ee737edd94
messages.subject: Re: [StatForLing with R] Reanalyzing the classes in a data frame
parts:
Like this?

# generate a data frame
x <- c("a", 1, 2, "b")
y <- c(0, 1, 2, "b")
z <- c("a", 1, 2, 3)
a <- data.frame(x, y, z); str(a)

# subset with [] so that only numbers remain
b <- a[2:3,]
str(b) # still factors

# reclassify
b[] <- apply(b, 2, as.numeric)

# check the result
str(b) # done


Cheers,
STG
